title_en: In our village, a boxwood house
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: The last stanza's 'татко да ти видов' and 'мојто либе тамо' are my reading; the sense is that the narrator sees his sweetheart with another man.

lines.en: In our village, a boxwood house,
oh handsome girl, a colorful room.

lines.cyr: Тамо се собрале сите млади момци,
lines.lat: Tamo se sobrale site mladi momci,
lines.en: There all the young lads gathered,

lines.cyr: де дилбер моме редум со момите.
lines.lat: de dilber mome redum so momite.
lines.en: oh handsome girl, in a row with the girls.

lines.cyr: Јас си дома чекам либе да ми дојде,
lines.lat: Jas si doma čekam libe da mi dojde,
lines.en: I wait at home for my sweetheart to come,

lines.cyr: де дилбер моме либе ќе дојди.
lines.lat: de dilber mome libe ḱe dojdi.
lines.en: oh handsome girl, the sweetheart will come.

lines.cyr: Малку го почекав и го недочекав,
lines.lat: Malku go počekav i go nedočekav,
lines.en: I waited a little and did not wait for her,

lines.cyr: де дилбер моме на седенка појдов.
lines.lat: de dilber mome na sedenka pojdov.
lines.en: oh handsome girl, I went to the gathering.

lines.cyr: Кратко си почукав, врата се отвори,
lines.lat: Kratko si počukav, vrata se otvori,
lines.en: I knocked briefly, the door opened,

lines.cyr: де дилбер моме татко да ти видов,
lines.lat: de dilber mome tatko da ti vidov,
lines.en: oh handsome girl, I saw your father,

lines.cyr: де дилбер моме мојто либе тамо.
lines.lat: de dilber mome mojto libe tamo.
lines.en: oh handsome girl, my sweetheart there.

lines.cyr: Колку лесно било моме да се лаже,
lines.lat: Kolku lesno bilo mome da se laže,
lines.en: How easy it is, girl, to be deceived,

lines.cyr: де дилбер моме самата го видов,
lines.lat: de dilber mome samata go vidov,
lines.en: oh handsome girl, I saw it myself,

lines.cyr: де дилбер моме ерген да се љуби.
lines.lat: de dilber mome ergen da se ljubi.
lines.en: oh handsome girl, her kissing a bachelor.
